1.explanation:
• packages/react/src/components/Tabs/Tabs.mdx  – the MDX documentation needs to show the new icon-only usage examples and describe the variant.
• packages/react/src/components/Tabs/index.js  – the public entry point for Tabs; may need to export new prop support or types for icon-only.
• packages/react/src/components/Tabs/Tabs.js  – the default Tabs implementation must detect when its Tab children are icon-only and pass a modifier class down to the nav items.
• packages/react/src/components/Tabs/next/Tabs.js  – the vNext Tabs file also needs the same logic for icon-only children.
• packages/react/src/components/Tabs/next/ContainedTabs.js  – the contained version must likewise support icon-only tabs with fixed width and gray background.
• packages/react/src/components/Tabs/next/Tabs.stories.js  – update the Storybook story to demonstrate both line and contained icon-only variants.
• packages/react/src/components/Tab/Tab.js  – the base Tab component must add an “icon-only” CSS class when renderIcon is supplied without children, so that the SCSS rules apply.
• packages/react/src/components/Tab/next/Tab.js  – vNext default Tab component needs the same detection and class name.
• packages/react/src/components/Tab/next/ContainedTab.js  – the contained-style Tab must also render the icon-only modifier class.
• packages/carbon-react/scss/components/tabs/_tabs.scss  – the Sass must define new styles under .bx--tabs__nav-item--icon-only (and for the contained variant) that center the 20px icon in a 48px-wide button, adjust padding/margins, and handle the underline or background correctly.
1.bug_scenario: The request is to add an “icon-only” variant to both the default (line) Tabs and the ContainedTabs components. In the reproduction example each Tab is rendered with only the renderIcon prop and no label, and the layout should enforce a fixed tab width of 48px (with a 20px-wide icon centered) and use the correct underline vs. gray container styling. Currently, when you omit children and only pass renderIcon, the tabs either collapse or retain the standard text padding, so the dimensions and visual treatment are incorrect.

2.explanation:
All of the above files are responsible for rendering and styling tabs and individual tab items. 

• Tab.js (classic & next) and ContainedTab.js implement the Tab component’s markup and classes; they need logic to detect an icon-only tab (no children/text but a renderIcon prop) and to apply a new modifier class (e.g. --icon-only) so that the layout changes to center a 20px icon.  

• Tabs.js (classic & next) and ContainedTabs.js wrap Tab components; they will need to pass through or recognize the icon-only variant to adjust spacing or container styles. 

• _tabs.scss is the source of the tab styling in CSS; it must be updated with rules for the .bx--tabs__nav-item--icon-only (and the contained equivalent) to set fixed icon width, center alignment, and 48px inter-tab spacing for both line and contained tabs.
2.bug_scenario: The Tabs component currently only supports text labels and doesn’t adjust its layout when only an icon is provided via the renderIcon prop. When a consumer renders Tabs/Tab without any children or label—only renderIcon—the tabs remain the same width and spacing as text‐only tabs, resulting in misaligned icons and incorrect padding. The design spec calls for an “icon‐only” variant for both line tabs (underline style) and contained tabs (filled style) where each tab is centered around a 20×20 icon with 48px spacing between tabs.
